shared_tail.surface: عبد الحميد بن عبد الرحمن، بن زيد
محمد بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: Branch 1 ends at «إبراهيم» (يعني ابن سعد, gloss left out); branch 2's «أبي» is the father of يعقوب. The text does not name them as one man in this report, so they are not merged (rule 9).
«أباه سعدا» is one link named by its name alone (rule 7); Sa'd relays the Prophet's words; the story's «قال عمر» is scene, not a link.
